nodes.description: This file contains a few facts regarding the continuity of affine maps.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.AffineSubspace
nodes.description: This file defines the embedding map from an affine subspace to the ambient space as a continuous affine map.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Algebra
nodes.description: A topological algebra over a topological semiring R is a topological semiring with a compatible continuous scalar multiplication by elements of R. We reuse typeclass ContinuousSMul for topological algebras.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Algebra.Equiv
nodes.description: This file contains an API for ContinuousAlgEquiv R A B, the type of continuous R-algebra isomorphisms with continuous inverses. Here R is a commutative (semi)ring, and A and B are R-algebras with topologies.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Algebra.Rat
nodes.description: This is just a minimal stub for now!

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.AsymptoticCone
nodes.description: This file defines the asymptotic cone of a set in a topological affine space.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Category.ProfiniteGrp.Basic
nodes.description: We say G is a profinite group if it is a topological group which is compact and totally disconnected.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Category.ProfiniteGrp.Completion
nodes.description: We define the profinite completion of a group as the limit of its finite quotients, and prove its universal property.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Category.ProfiniteGrp.Limits
nodes.descriptionTitle: A profinite group is the projective limit of finite groups
nodes.description: We define the topological group isomorphism between a profinite group and the projective limit of its quotients by open normal subgroups.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.ClopenNhdofOne
nodes.descriptionTitle: Existence of an open normal subgroup in any clopen neighborhood of the neutral element
nodes.description: This file proves the lemma IsTopologicalGroup.exist_openNormalSubgroup_sub_clopen_nhds_of_one, which states that in a compact topological group, for any clopen neighborhood of 1, there exists an open normal subgroup contained within it.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.ConstMulAction
nodes.descriptionTitle: Monoid actions continuous in the second variable
nodes.description: In this file we define class ContinuousConstSMul. We say ContinuousConstSMul Γ T if Γ acts on T and for each γ, the map x ↦ γ • x is continuous. (This differs from ContinuousSMul, which requires simultaneous continuity in both variables.)

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Constructions
nodes.descriptionTitle: Topological space structure on the opposite monoid and on the units group
nodes.description: In this file we define TopologicalSpace structure on Mᵐᵒᵖ, Mᵃᵒᵖ, Mˣ, and AddUnits M. This file does not import definitions of a topological monoid and/or a continuous multiplicative action, so we postpone the proofs of ContinuousMul Mᵐᵒᵖ etc. till we have these definitions.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Constructions.DomMulAct
nodes.descriptionTitle: Topological space structure on Mᵈᵐᵃ and Mᵈᵃᵃ
nodes.description: In this file we define TopologicalSpace structure on Mᵈᵐᵃ and Mᵈᵃᵃ and prove basic theorems about these topologies. The topologies on Mᵈᵐᵃ and Mᵈᵃᵃ are the same as the topology on M. Formally, they are induced by DomMulAct.mk.symm and DomAddAct.mk.symm, since the types aren't definitionally equal.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.ContinuousAffineEquiv
nodes.description: In this file, we define continuous affine equivalences, affine equivalences which are continuous with continuous inverse.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.ContinuousAffineMap
nodes.description: This file defines a type of bundled continuous affine maps.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.ContinuousMonoidHom
nodes.description: This file defines the space of continuous homomorphisms between two topological groups.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Equicontinuity
nodes.description: Module documentation is present for Topology.Algebra.Equicontinuity.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Field
nodes.description: A topological division ring is a topological ring whose inversion function is continuous at every non-zero element.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.FilterBasis
nodes.description: A GroupFilterBasis is a FilterBasis on a group with some properties relating the basis to the group structure. The main theorem is that a GroupFilterBasis on a group gives a topology on the group which makes it into a topological group with neighborhoods of the neutral element generated by the given basis.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.AddTorsor
nodes.description: This file defines topological torsors of additive groups, that is, torsors where +ᵥ and -ᵥ are continuous.

nodes.description: This file defines the following typeclasses:

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.Compact

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.CompactOpen

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.GroupTopology

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.Matrix

nodes.description: We prove that a continuous surjective group morphism from a sigma-compact group to a locally compact group is automatically open, in MonoidHom.isOpenMap_of_sigmaCompact.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.Pointwise
nodes.descriptionTitle: Pointwise operations on sets in topological groups

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.Quotient

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.SubmonoidClosure
nodes.descriptionTitle: Topological closure of the submonoid closure
nodes.description: In this file we prove several versions of the following statement: if G is a compact topological group and s : Set G, then the topological closures of Submonoid.closure s and Subgroup.closure s are equal.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Group.TopologicalAbelianization

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.GroupCompletion
nodes.description: This file endows the completion of a topological abelian group with a group structure. More precisely the instance UniformSpace.Completion.addGroup builds an abelian group structure on the completion of an abelian group endowed with a compatible uniform structure. Then the instance UniformSpace.Completion.isUniformAddGroup proves this group structure is compatible with the completed uniform structure. The compatibility condition is IsUniformAddGroup.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.GroupWithZero
nodes.description: In this file we define ContinuousInv₀ to be a mixin typeclass a type with Inv and Zero (e.g., a GroupWithZero) such that fun x ↦ x⁻¹ is continuous at all nonzero points. Any normed (semi)field has this property. Currently the only example of ContinuousInv₀ in mathlib which is not a normed field is the type NNReal (a.k.a. ℝ≥0) of nonnegative real numbers.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Indicator

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Basic

nodes.description: This file contains many simple lemmas on tsum, HasSum etc, which are placed here in order to keep the basic file of definitions as short as possible.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.ConditionalInt
nodes.description: This file contains some lemmas about sums over symmetric integer intervals Ixx -N N used, for example in the definition of the Eisenstein series E2. In particular we define symmetricIcc, symmetricIco, symmetricIoc and symmetricIoo as SummationFilters corresponding to the intervals Icc -N N, Ico -N N, Ioc -N N respectively. We also prove that these filters are all NeBot and LeAtTop.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Constructions
nodes.description: Lemmas on the interaction of tprod, tsum, HasProd, HasSum etc. with products, Sigma and Pi types, MulOpposite, etc.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Defs
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sum and product in a topological monoid
nodes.description: This file defines infinite products and sums for (possibly infinite) indexed families of elements in a commutative topological monoid (resp. add monoid).

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.DiscreteConvolution
nodes.description: Discrete convolution over monoids: (f ⋆[L] g) x = ∑' (a, b) : mulFiber x, L (f a) (g b) where mulFiber x = {(a, b) | a b = x}. Additive monoids are also supported.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.ENNReal
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sums in extended nonnegative reals
nodes.description: This file proves results on infinite sums in ℝ≥0∞.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Field
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sums and products in topological fields
nodes.description: Lemmas on topological sums in rings with a strictly multiplicative norm, of which normed fields are the most familiar examples.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Group
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sums and products in topological groups
nodes.description: Lemmas on topological sums in groups (as opposed to monoids).

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.GroupCompletion
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sums in the completion of a topological group

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Module
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sums in topological vector spaces
nodes.description: Module documentation is present for Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Module.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.NatInt
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sums and products over ℕ and ℤ
nodes.description: This file contains lemmas about HasSum, Summable, tsum, HasProd, Multipliable, and tprod applied to the important special cases where the domain is ℕ or ℤ. For instance, we prove the formula ∑ i ∈ range k, f i + ∑' i, f (i + k) = ∑' i, f i, ∈ sum_add_tsum_nat_add, as well as several results relating sums and products on ℕ to sums and products on ℤ.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Nonarchimedean
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sums and products in nonarchimedean abelian groups
nodes.description: Let G be a complete nonarchimedean abelian group and let f : α → G be a function. We prove that f is unconditionally summable if and only if f a tends to zero on the cofinite filter on α (NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_iff_tendsto_cofinite_zero). We also prove the analogous result in the multiplicative setting (NonarchimedeanGroup.multipliable_iff_tendsto_cofinite_one).

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Order
nodes.descriptionTitle: Infinite sum or product in an order
nodes.description: This file provides lemmas about the interaction of infinite sums and products and order operations.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Real
nodes.description: This file provides lemmas about Cauchy sequences in terms of infinite sums and infinite sums valued in the reals.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Ring
nodes.description: This file provides lemmas about the interaction between infinite sums and multiplication.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.SummationFilter
nodes.description: We define a SummationFilter on β to be a filter on the finite subsets of β. These are used in defining summability: if L is a summation filter, we define the L-sum of f to be the limit along L of the sums over finsets (if this limit exists). This file only develops the basic machinery of summation filters - the key definitions HasSum, tsum and summable (and their product variants) are in the file Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/InfiniteSum/Defs.lean.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.TsumUniformlyOn
nodes.description: We prove some HasSumUniformlyOn versions of theorems from Mathlib.Analysis.NormedSpace.FunctionSeries.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.IsOpenUnits
nodes.description: We say that a topological monoid M has open units (IsOpenUnits) if Mˣ is open in M and has the subspace topology (i.e. inverse is continuous).

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.IsUniformGroup.Basic
nodes.description: quotients of first countable topological groups by normal subgroups are themselves complete, for the left uniformity. We also give versions for the right uniformity. In particular, the quotient of a Banach space by a subspace is complete.

nodes.descriptionTitle: Constructions of new uniform groups from old ones

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.IsUniformGroup.Defs
nodes.description: Given a topological group G, one can naturally build two uniform structures (the "left" and "right" ones) on G inducing its topology. This file defines typeclasses for groups equipped with either of these uniform structures, as well as a separate typeclass for the (very common) case where the given uniform structure coincides with both the left and right uniform structures.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.IsUniformGroup.DiscreteSubgroup
nodes.description: Note that the instance Subgroup.isClosed_of_discrete does not live here, in order that it can be used in other files without requiring lots of group-theoretic imports.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.IsUniformGroup.Order
nodes.description: We gather some results about TendstoUniformlyOn f g K on ordered spaces, in particular bounding the values of f in terms of bounds on the limit g.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.LinearMapCompletion
nodes.description: This file has a declaration that enables a continuous (semi-)linear map between modules to be lifted to a continuous semilinear map between the completions of those modules.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.LinearTopology
nodes.descriptionTitle: Linear topologies on modules and rings
nodes.description: Let M be a (left) module over a ring R. Following Stacks: Definition 15.36.1, we say that a topology on M is R-linear if it is invariant by translations and admits a basis of neighborhoods of 0 consisting of (left) R-submodules.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Localization
nodes.description: The topological localization of a topological commutative ring R at a submonoid M is the ring Localization M endowed with the final ring topology of the natural homomorphism sending x : R to the equivalence class of (x, 1) in the localization of R at an M.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.MetricSpace.Lipschitz
nodes.description: This file develops Lipschitz continuous functions further with some results that depend on algebra.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Alternating.Basic
nodes.description: In this file we define bundled continuous alternating maps and develop basic API about these maps, by reusing API about continuous multilinear maps and alternating maps.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Alternating.Topology
nodes.description: In this file we define UniformSpace and TopologicalSpace structures on the space of continuous alternating maps between topological vector spaces.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Basic
nodes.description: We use the class ContinuousSMul for topological (semi) modules and topological vector spaces.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Cardinality
nodes.descriptionTitle: Cardinality of open subsets of vector spaces
nodes.description: Any nonempty open subset of a topological vector space over a nontrivially normed field has the same cardinality as the whole space. This is proved in cardinal_eq_of_isOpen.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.ClosedSubmodule
nodes.descriptionTitle: Closed submodules of a topological module
nodes.description: This file builds the frame of closed R-submodules of a topological module M.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Compact
nodes.description: Module documentation is present for Topology.Algebra.Module.Compact.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Complement
nodes.description: Let M be a topological R-module. Two submodules p, q of M are said to be topological complements (Submodule.IsTopCompl) if they are algebraic complements and the algebraic isomorphism M ≃ p × q is a homeomorphism.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Basic
nodes.description: In this file we define the type of continuous (semi)linear maps between topological modules that are continuous, and endow it with its algebraic structure.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Idempotent
nodes.description: In this file, we study the idempotent elements (IsIdempotentElem) of the ring M →L[R] M of continuous endomorphisms of a topological R-module M.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.PiProd
nodes.descriptionTitle: Continuous linear maps on products and Pi types
nodes.description: In this file, we collect various constructions relating continuous linear maps with (binary or arbitrary) products.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Quotient
nodes.descriptionTitle: Continuous linear maps and quotient topological modules
nodes.description: In this file, we collect various continuous linear maps associated to quotient spaces.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.Restrict

nodes.description: In this file, we collect the various operations of restrictions of ContinuousLinearMaps to subspaces of the domain/codomain.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.ContinuousLinearMap.RestrictScalars
nodes.descriptionTitle: Restriction of scalars for continuous linear maps
nodes.description: In this file, we define and study ContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars, which reinterprets a continuous R-linear map as a continuous S-linear map, for suitable R and S. This is the continuous version of LinearMap.restrictScalars.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Determinant
nodes.descriptionTitle: The determinant of a continuous linear map.
nodes.description: Module documentation is present for Topology.Algebra.Module.Determinant.

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.Equiv

nodes.label: Topology.Algebra.Module.LinearMapPiProd
